system.description:
Self-taught, with no institution behind you: closer kin to the hedge-mages of the back roads and the slums than to any tower.

  • Unexpected Caster: once per encounter, when you cast your first harmful spell of the fight, one creature that has not seen you cast a spell before has Disadvantage on its save against it.
    • 9th level: two such creatures.
  • Make It Work: you need no spellcasting focus for common components. Once per day, with 10 minutes' work, you can stand in for a costed component worth 10 gp or less; the GM says what will do.
